subject: Sponsor visibility + compliance contact scout
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Sandoval <alex.sandoval@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jun 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor visibility + compliance contact scout

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and three asks so we can move this to procurement prep: 

1) What we heard (short):
- Primary use case: embedding patient intake summaries into clinician notes to reduce admin time for care teams.
- Key non-negotiables: data residency in US, audit log access, retention TTL configurable per dataset.
- Expected pilot scope: 3 clinics, ~5000 notes/month for 90 days.

2) Immediate asks (can you help with these by EOW?):
- Please share a short org chart / list that shows who approves vendor spend (names + titles) — we mainly need who signs (legal/finance) and the economic buyer.
- Point us to the security/contact for questionnaires (Sig/vendor risk or InfoSec contact) and the procurement email alias.
- Any decision criteria or RFP checklist you already use (or an internal doc) — even a short bullet list helps.

3) Proposed next steps:
- You: quick intro to econ buyer and security contact (2–3 lines + calendar availability).
- Us: we’ll prepare a 20-min compliance + commercial playbook tailored to your requirements and a simple mutual action plan.

Attaching a short one-pager that lists the specific artifacts we usually need so your team can route internally. If helpful, Ben (cc'd) can run a short procurement checklist call with your procurement owner.

Thanks — look forward to the intros.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: procurement-playbook-request.docx (docx)]
From: Alex Sandoval <alex.sandoval@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor visibility + compliance contact scout

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side below.

- Economic buyer: Priya Shah, VP Product (pri.chen@greenfieldhealth.com / priya.shah@greenfieldhealth.com). She owns vendor approvals for pilot spend.
- Legal / Contracts: procurement email is procure@greenfieldhealth.com (they triage to Legal Contracts team).
- Security contact: Ravi Menon, Director, InfoSec (ravi.menon@greenfieldhealth.com).

Decision criteria (short bullets):
- PHI-safe handling / ability to run in our VPC or approved cloud regions.
- Audit logs for token-level access & redaction support.
- SLA for latency under median 350ms for our baseline payload.
- Cost predictability and easy rollback to quantized variants.

I’ll introduce Priya and Ravi on a separate thread with a 15–20 minute window next week — wedge slots Tue/Wed 10–12 ET. I’ve attached the rough vendor questionnaire we typically send.

Alex
Head of Data & Ops | Greenfield Health
alex.sandoval@greenfieldhealth.com
[Attachment: GFH-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

Alex / Camila — appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple of pragmatic asks from our side before the intro to Priya & Ravi: 

- Can you confirm whether pilot funds route through the central procurement PO process or if Priya can sign using delegated spending authority? That affects the commercial paperwork we bring to the first procurement sync.
- If procurement prefers an NDA first, we can share a one-way NDA now (lean) — otherwise we’ll include a short commercial worksheet on the intro.

Camila — I’ll draft a 20-min agenda for the procurement sync (who’s needed, artifacts to bring, and a simple decision timeline). Alex — feel free to add anything you expect procurement/legal to require.

Thanks all — adding a short checklist we use to accelerate procurement/security conversations. Attaching our compliance summary and a stripped-down SOC2 evidence checklist (we’ll only ask what’s needed for a 90-day pilot).

Quick checklist (what we can prepare in advance):
- Short scoping addendum (pilot definition, metrics, rollback triggers).
- A tailored compliance packet: SOC2 excerpts, encryption details, data residency attestations.
- A simple commercial worksheet: pilot pricing, invoicing options, cancellation terms.
- Point person for technical onboarding + IP questions (we recommend a 30-min tech touch with your infra/DevOps lead).

Alex — if you can introduce Priya and Ravi on a thread with 2–3 candidate times (Tue/Wed 10–12 ET), we’ll lock a slot and share the two-pager we referenced.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
